system.description:
[Trigger: Instant] "Target: Single / Range: 4Sq" used against a target. Gives [Rigor] to the target. If the target does not receive any HP damage during this main process, the [Rigor] is removed upon the end of the main process. Once per scene. Arrow of Maleficent Gaze An arrow crafted to release curses along with its shaft, imbued with a magic stone said to possess the power of maleficent gaze. Those who witness its shot have their souls pierced, and are subjected to an invisible binding.

Snake-Eye Stone [Core Material] (100G) + Light Crossbow (230G) ×2 + [Magic Catalyst 6] (50G) ×2 + Crafting Cost (230G)
